resources.string: This reviewed APK is inert until trusted production enrollment is provisioned.
There is no calendar shutdown date. Stop is explicit, by revocation, or by an invalid safety gate.
Signed assignments and the fixed official TeleBirr route only. No editable URL or API key.
No database, KemerBet, settlement, or financial-action authority.

On the authenticated Owner page, create one short-lived phone pairing package. Paste only that package here. It is one-use and is not an API key, receipt reference, receiver name, or account credential.
Continue only if this package was just created in the authenticated FetanAgent Owner page. The device private key will remain non-exportable in Android Keystore.
Visible health and stop control for the dedicated verifier phone
Dedicated operator phone continuously polls short-lived signed TeleBirr evidence assignments, uploads evidence only, and exposes a persistent health and stop notification.
